workCases.name: Analyticity
workCases.title: Analyticity platform overhaul
workCases.body: Traffic jams, accidents, hazards and road closures lived in separate fragmented views. I rebuilt them into one map-based workflow where a street, a period and a comparison are three clicks apart.
workCases.imageAlt: Analyticity traffic analytics interface after the redesign

workCases.name: Pockland
workCases.title: Pockland
workCases.meta: Product thinking, UI, AI-assisted prototyping, build
workCases.body: A book tracker I took from a mobile-first prototype to a working responsive app: real accounts, synced data, and discovery through Open Library and Google Books.

workCases.name: Wake & Wine
workCases.title: Wake & Wine
workCases.meta: Interviews, drink-entry flow, React and FastAPI
workCases.body: Habit trackers either moralise or make logging too slow to keep up. I designed a neutral one: pick a drink, see the glasses, watch the total — then read your month back as patterns and spending.
workCases.imageAlt: Wake and Wine completed drink entry screen

workCases.name: Thermo Fisher
workCases.title: Instrument control at Thermo Fisher Scientific
workCases.body: My day job: the software scientists and engineers use to drive electron microscopes. I can’t publish the screens — proprietary parameters, algorithms and scientific data.

workCases.name: PeePoint
workCases.title: PeePoint
workCases.body: A survey turned a small inconvenience into a product direction: people plan trips on a laptop but need the saved places in their hand on the street.
